body.description: One REST GoogleAdsRow of Q-G2, the campaign keyset scan: WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED' AND campaign.id > {last_id} ORDER BY campaign.id LIMIT 9999, continued from the last id while a page returns exactly 9,999 rows (AAP 0.3.3). Also one row of Q-G2b: the same fields with campaign.id IN ({at most 1,000 tracked ids missing from a complete Q-G2 scan}) and no status filter, so REMOVED campaigns are returned; a tracked campaign returned as REMOVED is snapshotted as ended, and one not returned at all raises a missing discrepancy, but only after a complete scan (safe absence). Each row arrives as an element of results[] in the google.search envelope (search.json). Plan correction: campaign_budget.total_amount_micros is added to the AAP's Q-G2 select, because in v25 a CUSTOM_PERIOD (lifetime) budget's amount lives in total_amount_micros while amount_micros is unset; the own_budget total_budget decision field and the C0 budget comparison need it (AAP 0.5.2); connectors/google_n8n/queries.py makes the same addition for Q-G2 and Q-G2b. Keys are camelCase REST; int64 values (ids, *Micros) arrive as JSON strings. campaign.resourceName is always returned for the FROM resource, and campaignBudget.resourceName is returned because campaign_budget fields are selected (GAQL query structure: an attributed resource's resource_name is returned when at least one of its fields is selected). Feeds campaign entity snapshots (status, budget_amount_micros, budget_id), dated shared-budget membership (budget_id), explicitly shared budget subjects, C0 status and budget discrepancies, and daily-budget utilization (AAP 0.5.2, 0.5.4).

campaign.description: The campaign resource (FROM campaign). Snapshotted every entity sync as entity_type=campaign; campaign.external_id is id, raw_status keeps status, objective_or_channel keeps advertisingChannelType.

resourceName.description: customers/{customer_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}. Returned for the FROM resource although not selected (omit_unselected_resource_names defaults to false).

id.description: INT64 campaign id as a decimal string; output only. The keyset field of Q-G2 (ORDER BY campaign.id, campaign.id > last id) and the id list of Q-G2b; read by partition.enumerate_campaigns through get_field.

name.description: STRING campaign name, shown in evidence and used by the C3b name check.

status.description: CampaignStatusEnum (v25). Q-G2 excludes REMOVED; Q-G2b has no status filter and can return REMOVED. Normalised by CAMPAIGN_STATUS_MAP: ENABLED to active, PAUSED to paused, REMOVED to ended; the raw value is kept as raw_status.

advertisingChannelType.description: AdvertisingChannelTypeEnum (v25); immutable after creation. Stored as the campaign's objective_or_channel.

campaignBudget.description: The attributed campaign_budget resource. Present whenever the campaign references a campaign budget; when absent, the campaign has no budget row (budget_id null) and is excluded from cap and utilization rules.

resourceName.description: customers/{customer_id}/campaignBudgets/{campaign_budget_id}. Returned because at least one campaign_budget field is selected.

id.description: INT64 campaign budget id as a decimal string; output only. The budget's external_id and the campaign snapshot's budget_id, which gives dated shared-budget membership (AAP 0.5.4.5).

amountMicros.description: INT64 as a string: the DAILY budget amount in micros of the account currency (1,000,000 micros = one currency unit). Unset for CUSTOM_PERIOD; mutually exclusive with totalAmountMicros. Kept as budget.amount_micros and compared at native precision by C0.

totalAmountMicros.description: INT64 as a string: the CUSTOM_PERIOD (lifetime) budget amount in micros of the account currency. Unset for DAILY; mutually exclusive with amountMicros. Plan correction: added to the Q-G2 and Q-G2b select so the own_budget total_budget field and C0 can read lifetime budgets.

period.description: BudgetPeriodEnum (v25); immutable, DAILY by default. DAILY budgets get utilization; CUSTOM_PERIOD budgets show utilization as n/a and are excluded from cap rules (AAP 0.5.4.1). Decides which amount field the own_budget and budget decision shapes accept (daily_budget for DAILY, total_budget for CUSTOM_PERIOD).

explicitlyShared.description: BOOLEAN. true marks an explicitly shared budget, a decision subject of its own whose member campaigns take the shared_member shape (AAP 0.5.2); a shared budget can never become non-shared. A CUSTOM_PERIOD budget cannot be explicitly shared. The key may be omitted when false under proto3 JSON default-value omission, and consumers treat absence as false.
